#  Steelers select Allen in the fifth round
*   *   *   * Copied!

Marcus Allen** **Safety**  
**Penn State**  
**6-2, 215**  
**Upper Marlboro, Md.**  
**Dr. Henry Wise High School**  
**5th Round â 148th Overall**

**CAREER NOTES**  
Became the sixth player in Penn State history to reach the 300-tackle mark in a career, finishing fifth in school history with 321 stopsâ¦produced double-digit tackles in nine games.

2017 SEASON**  
First-team All-Big Ten accolades from the coaches and second-team honors from the mediaâ¦Associated Press first-team All-Big Ten selectionâ¦earned the Lott IMPACT Trophy Player of the Week after recording 13 tackles vs. Pittsburghâ¦started all 13 games, totaling 72 tackles (46 solo) with one interception and two forced fumblesâ¦selected as a team captainâ¦one of 21 Penn State players to enter the Fiesta Bowl having already earned a degree.

**2016 SEASON**  
All-Big Ten third-team selection by the coaches and honorable mention by the media panelâ¦selected Big Ten Co-Defensive Player of the Week for a 22-tackle game vs. Minnesotaâ¦started all 14 gamesâ¦posted 10 tackles or more in three gamesâ¦recorded a career-high 110 tackles en route to becoming the first safety to lead Penn State in tackles since 2002 (Shawn Mayer).

**2015 SEASON**  
Named All-Big Ten honorable mention by the coaches and mediaâ¦started all 12 gamesâ¦finished second on the Nittany Lions defense with 81 tackles.

2014 SEASON**  
Appeared in 13 games with seven startsâ¦started the final seven games of the seasonâ¦tied for third on the squad with 58 tackles (35 solo), along with adding three pass breakups and one sackâ¦part of a defense that held 11 of 13 opponents to under 300 yards of total offense and limited nine teams to 20 or fewer points in regulation.

**HIGH SCHOOL**  
A three-year letterman at Dr. Henry Wise (Upper Marlboro, Md.) High Schoolâ¦posted 15 tackles and two fumble recoveries in three games as a senior before suffering an ankle injuryâ¦as a junior, helped advance the Pumas to a perfect 14-0 record and the Maryland 4A State Championshipâ¦produced 70 tackles, three interceptions and 10 pass breakups in junior yearâ¦was invited to participate in the Big 33 Classic and Maryland Crab Bowl following his senior year.
